tools.name: quokkapix.apply_recipe
tools.description: Applies an official recipe id or custom recipe JSON to configure a local browser workflow. Files must still be uploaded through the browser input. This does not start processing.

tools.name: quokkapix.apply_settings
tools.description: Applies browser-agent settings for mode, tool, scenario steps and tool options. Files must still be supplied through the browser file input or dropzone.

tools.name: quokkapix.cancel
tools.description: Cancels the current QuokkaPix browser-side processing run.

tools.name: quokkapix.get_contract
tools.description: Returns the QuokkaPix browser-agent contract, supported image tools, DOM selectors, payment policy and local browser processing constraints.

tools.name: quokkapix.get_payment_policy
tools.description: Returns free and paid agent-use rules. Single image runs, single scenarios and small batches up to 5 files are free; larger agent batch/scenario runs use x402 unlock.

tools.name: quokkapix.get_recipe
tools.description: Returns one official QuokkaPix recipe by id. The recipe includes applySettings JSON, limits, payment requirement and expected result manifest contract.

tools.name: quokkapix.get_result_manifest
tools.description: Returns a machine-readable browser-local processing result, source and output dimensions when available, warnings, capabilities and stable error code.

tools.name: quokkapix.get_rule_profile
tools.description: Returns one sourced platform image requirement profile by id, including requirements, recommendations, source URL, source type and confidence.

tools.name: quokkapix.get_state
tools.description: Returns current browser-side processing state, selected tool, upload mode, file count, progress, output metadata and payment state.

tools.name: quokkapix.list_recipes
tools.description: Returns official QuokkaPix browser-local image workflow recipes such as Shopify product pack, Amazon white background pack, metadata clean batch and website WebP compression.

tools.name: quokkapix.list_rule_profiles
tools.description: Returns sourced marketplace and social image requirement profiles used by QuokkaPix QA reports. Secondary sources are marked explicitly.

tools.name: quokkapix.set_unlock_token
tools.description: Stores a short-lived x402 unlock token returned by QuokkaPix payment endpoint. The token is verified and consumed when a paid agent batch run starts.

tools.name: quokkapix.start
tools.description: State-changing action: starts the selected QuokkaPix local browser workflow after files have been uploaded through the page. Single-image runs and small agent batches up to 5 files are free. Larger agent batch/scenario runs require a valid paid unlock token and may consume that unlock when processing starts.

tools.name: quokkapix.validate_recipe
tools.description: Validates a recipe id or custom recipe object before applying it. This does not upload files and does not start processing.
